related.description: 💻 A better and friendly vi(vim) mode plugin for ZSH.
All the motions you could ask for and more for Zsh's vi mode.
Zsh: Vim-style increment/decrement in vicmd, visual keymaps
Access external clipboards in vi-mode keymaps
System clipboard key bindings for Zsh Line Editor with vi mode. It is similar to what `set clipboard=unnamed` does for vim.
